title: JSON schema for the Retraceur extension manifest

$schema.description: Allows editors and tools to validate the manifest against this schema.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the Retraceur manifest schema.

name.description: The unique identifier for the resource. It must match its GitHub repository full name, structured as `owner/repo`.

type.description: The type of resource described by this manifest.

requires.description: The requirements the resource needs to run: minimum Retraceur and PHP versions, and any other Retraceur resource it depends on.

retraceur.description: The minimum required version of Retraceur, such as 4.0.0. Treated as a minimum, not an exact match.

php.description: The minimum required version of PHP, such as 7.4. Treated as a minimum, not an exact match.

dependencies.description: Other Retraceur resources (plugins or blocks) this resource depends on. Each dependency is resolved from its GitHub repository.

repo.description: The GitHub repository full name of the dependency, formatted as `owner/repo`.

version.description: Version constraint the dependency must satisfy. Accepts a bare version (treated as a minimum), a version prefixed with `>=`, `<=`, `>`, `<` or `=`, or a caret range (`^X.Y.Z`). Omit to accept any installed version.

url.description: A URL for the author, such as their website or GitHub profile.
